Junior Developer, AI Team

Nashville, TN
Job Type
Full-time
Description

Salary: $60,000

Job Type: Full-Time (Exempt)

QuaverEd is a rapidly growing, innovative education technology company founded in 2009. Our mission is enriching the lives of children by helping educators to engage students in general music, social and emotional learning, as well as health and physical education. We are headquartered in historic Music Row in Nashville, Tennessee. Check out our website at QuaverEd.com.

The AI team is small and builds fast. We ship internal tools, content pipelines, and platform features that put AI to practical use across engineering, product, curriculum, sales, and operations. The Junior Developer keeps the AI team's growing set of applications healthy and adds capacity for new project work when we need it. You'll report to the Director of AI.

Most weeks, the majority of your time goes to maintaining and supporting apps already in production: fixing bugs, handling requests from the teams who use them, keeping dependencies current, and watching for problems before users find them. The rest goes to project work alongside other engineers, where you'll build features, prototype, and learn how we design AI-assisted tools.

Job Duties:

Application maintenance and support

Own day-to-day upkeep of internal web apps and services: bug fixes, small enhancements, dependency and security updates;
Triage and resolve requests from internal users in curriculum, art, sales, and operations;
Monitor logs, errors, and costs on cloud deployments and flag issues early;
Keep documentation, runbooks, and READMEs current so anyone on the team can pick up an app;
Manage access, environment config, and secrets according to our default-deny security practices; and
Stakeholder management: Handle requests from other teams with patience and diplomacy. When a request is not possible, explain the reason clearly and propose practical alternatives.

Project Work

Build features and prototypes on new projects with guidance from senior engineers;
Write tests and QA your own work before it reaches review;
Use AI coding tools (Claude Code and similar) daily, and review their output with a critical eye; and
Package changes for the company release cycle and work with QC through patch, alpha, and beta phases.

Team

Join project planning work, team meetings.
Share what you learn; we expect juniors to grow fast and teach back.
Requirements
0–2 years of professional development experience, or equivalent through a degree, bootcamp, or a solid portfolio of shipped projects;
Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript and at least one of React or Node.js;
Some Python, or the willingness to pick it up quickly;
Comfort with Git, pull requests, and reading code you didn't write;
Basic SQL and an understanding of how web apps talk to APIs and databases;
Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants, and the judgment to know when not to trust them;
Clear written communication; you can explain a fix to a non-technical teammate; and
Follow-through on unglamorous work. Maintenance is the core of this job.

Nice to Have

Google Cloud experience (Cloud Run, Firebase, Firestore, Vertex AI) or AWS
Experience calling LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) or building with MCP
Familiarity with automated testing tools such as Playwright
Exposure to accessibility standards (WCAG) or localization work
Background or interest in music, education, or EdTech
Experience with BI or data pipelines

Please submit a resume and cover letter along with three references.

The job role is not a remote work position. All employees must live within commuting distance of Music Row in Nashville. We are currently requiring all team members to work at minimum 3 days a week in the office on the QuaverEd campus and allowing 2 days remote. This requirement is subject to change at the discretion of the team member's Supervisor and company policies.

QuaverEd, Inc. offers an excellent benefits package including 80 hours of vacation per year with an increase after 3 years, 12 paid holidays, 60 hours of sick leave, subsidized health care up to $9,000 per year, a 401(k) program with no participation fees. QuaverEd also offers full employer paid basic life, fertility, health advocate, teladoc, identity theft, and a collegial, supporting atmosphere.

QuaverEd, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, or genetic information.
